Word-bounded packets (`champollion packets split|verify|join`), motivated by Mouseia's 1845 Stirner edition, where Haiku drafts dropped 19 page markers across 128 packets. `original.md` is original synthetic CC0-1.0 text in the same shape: `[ID nnnn]` paragraph anchors, `[YYYY page]` page markers, headings and `[Note *)]` author-note lines; it is not the historical passage. Split at 50 words it yields four packets. `drafts/` holds a synthetic English draft of each: `001.md` and `002.md` are correct; `003.md` drops the `[Note **)]` line; `004.md` drops the page marker `[1845 3]` and reverses anchors `[GDN 0004]` and `[GDN 0005]`.
